system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

Your clans methodical skill and technique with medicine, enables you to utilize the First Aid Kit in ways other medics simply cannot. First Aid Kit’s you have can now have their effects applied over the course of 10 minutes, instead of a short or long rest, can affect creatures twice per rest, and for you, no long have use limits, can be used with no fear of running out of materials. Additionally, First Aid Kits you have count as a Medicine Kits for the purpose of using the Medical Check Up ability.
